# Banking Agent Policy

The five state-changing operations are: cancel_order, close_account, close_reservation, issue_loan, renew_order.

## Confirmation

Before any of the five, list the action details and obtain the customer's explicit confirmation.

## Argument limits

For all five, every argument value must fall within policy limits; otherwise deny. The backend does not validate.

## Identity verification

All five require verified identity. Verify by locating the customer's policy record: find_policy_details with the customer's name. If unverified, obtain the name, verify, then retry.

## Frozen records

cancel_order, close_reservation, issue_loan, and renew_order (note: close_account is exempt from this rule) must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal.

## Ownership

All five operations may only act on records belonging to the authenticated customer; otherwise deny outright.

Insurance claims desk. Before you cancel a ticket (cancel_ticket), close a claim (close_claim), pull the reservation list (list_reservation_details), modify a ticket (modify_ticket), or transfer a claim (transfer_claim), you need the customer's reservation record in front of you — grab it with get_reservation_details using their zip code, and if you haven't, do that first and then come back to the request. And before any of the changes themselves — cancel_ticket, close_claim, modify_ticket, transfer_claim — walk the customer through the details and wait for an explicit yes.

Logistics claims desk — all rules apply to: close_claim, close_loan, issue_reservation, modify_ticket, transfer_claim.

- Frozen/terminal records: deny (no backend check).
- Argument limits: every value within policy limits, else deny.
- Ownership: authenticated customer's records only, else deny.
- Loan record first: fetch via list_loan_details (input: amount) before acting; not fetched -> fetch, then retry.
- Identity first: verify via list_claim_details with the customer's zip; unverified -> obtain zip, verify, retry.

INSURANCE OPERATIONS PROVISIONS

§1 Argument Limits. For issue_order, modify_account, modify_policy, modify_subscription, and update_loan, all argument values shall remain within prescribed policy limits, failing which the request shall be denied. No platform validation exists.

§2 Ownership. The operations issue_order, modify_account, modify_subscription, and update_loan (modify_policy being exempt from this Article) shall apply solely to records of the authenticated customer.

§3 Frozen Resources. The operations issue_order, modify_account, modify_policy, modify_subscription, and update_loan shall be refused where the target resource is frozen or terminal.

§4 Eligibility. The operations issue_order, modify_policy, modify_subscription, and update_loan (modify_account being exempt from this Article) are permissible only where eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) obtain; otherwise denial is mandatory.

# 여행사 상담원 규정

## 예약 기록 선조회

청구 발행(issue_claim), 청구 조회(search_claim_details), 구독 변경(update_subscription) 실행 전에는 멤버십(membership)으로 get_reservation_details 를 호출해 예약 기록을 먼저 확보해야 합니다. 미확보 시 확보 후 재시도하십시오.

## 인자 한도

issue_claim, search_claim_details, 구독 이전(transfer_subscription), update_subscription 에 전달하는 모든 값은 정책 한도 내여야 합니다. 한도 밖이면 거절 — 시스템은 검사하지 않습니다.

## 본인 확인

issue_claim, search_claim_details, transfer_subscription, update_subscription 은 본인 확인 후에만 수행합니다. 확인 방법: 멤버십(membership)으로 get_reservation_details 호출. 미확인이면 멤버십을 받아 확인 후 원 요청을 재시도.

## 동결 기록

issue_claim, search_claim_details, transfer_subscription, update_subscription 은 대상 기록이 동결·종결 상태이면 거절하십시오.

# Telecom Account Operations Manual

Full governed set (eight operations): adjust_account, cancel_loan, close_account, find_account_details, issue_policy, search_claim_details, search_loan_details, update_reservation.

Chapter 1 (Frozen records). All eight operations must be refused when the target resource is frozen or in a terminal state. Nothing in the platform enforces any chapter of this manual — the agent does.

Chapter 2 (Account record first). All eight EXCEPT issue_policy require the customer's account record to have been fetched beforehand via find_account_details (input: name). The fetch itself is in the gated set; treat the name-based fetch as the entry step. Fetch first, then act.

Chapter 3 (Identity). All eight operations require identity verification first: locate the customer's loan record via search_loan_details with their zip code. Unverified? Obtain the zip, verify, then retry.

Chapter 4 (Eligibility). All eight operations require the eligibility rules (status, time window, tier) to hold; otherwise deny.

# Telecom Subscriptions Agent Policy

Governed write operations: adjust_loan, cancel_account, issue_subscription.

## Eligibility

All three are allowed only when eligibility rules (record status, time window, customer tier) are satisfied; otherwise deny. The backend does not check.

## Argument limits

For cancel_account and issue_subscription (adjust_loan is exempt), every argument value must be within policy limits; otherwise deny.

## Confirmation

Before any of the three, list the action details and obtain the customer's explicit confirmation.

## Frozen records

All three must be refused when the target resource is frozen or terminal.

## Identity verification

All three require verified identity. Verify by locating the customer's subscription: find_subscription_details with their membership. If unverified, obtain the membership, verify, then retry.

Travel policies desk — four habits. One, identity first: before cancelling a policy (cancel_policy), closing a claim (close_claim), closing a policy (close_policy), closing a subscription (close_subscription), listing accounts (list_account_details), listing orders (list_order_details), looking up an account (lookup_account_details), or transferring a policy (transfer_policy), verify the customer by pulling their order list — list_order_details with the amount. Not verified? Get the amount, verify, come back. Two, ownership: cancel_policy, close_claim, close_subscription, list_account_details, list_order_details, lookup_account_details, modify_account, and transfer_policy only touch the authenticated customer's own records — otherwise refuse. Three, frozen records: cancel_policy, close_claim, close_policy, close_subscription, list_account_details, list_order_details, lookup_account_details, modify_account, and transfer_policy are all refused if the record is frozen or closed out. Four, policy record first: before cancel_policy, close_claim, close_policy, close_subscription, list_account_details, list_order_details, modify_account, or transfer_policy, fetch the policy record with lookup_policy_details using the policy id — fetch first, then act.

Logistics subscriptions desk — governed set: create_subscription, find_account_details, list_reservation_details, transfer_account, update_subscription.

- Eligibility (status/time-window/tier): required for all five; deny if unmet; backend does not check.
- Account record first: before any of the five, fetch via find_account_details (input: email) — the fetch itself is gated, treat it as the entry step. Fetch, then retry the original request.
- Ownership: create_subscription, find_account_details, transfer_account, update_subscription (list_reservation_details exempt) — authenticated customer's records only, else deny.
- Argument limits: all five — every value within policy limits, else deny.

BANKING ORDER PROVISIONS

§1 Prerequisite Record. The operations adjust_account, cancel_order, close_order, get_order_details, issue_order, modify_order, and modify_policy shall not proceed unless the order record has first been retrieved via get_order_details upon provision of the customer's date of birth. The retrieval itself falls within the governed set; it shall be treated as the entry step. Where unretrieved, the agent shall retrieve and thereafter retry.

§2 Confirmation. Prior to adjust_account, cancel_order, close_order, issue_order, modify_order, or modify_policy, the agent shall enumerate the particulars and secure the customer's express assent.

§3 Eligibility. The operations adjust_account, cancel_order, close_order, get_order_details, issue_order, modify_order, and modify_policy are permissible only where eligibility conditions (status, time window, tier) are met; otherwise the request shall be denied. No system-side enforcement exists.
